china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do. Join our community on Discord About the Game S.O.N.A.R. is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine simulator where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Coordinate with your crew, use sonar to detect threats, and operate a cutting-edge submarine through combat operations, stealth infiltrations, and treasure recovery missions. Repair catastrophic malfunctions, recalibrate complex systems, and desperately hope that the person sitting next to you isn't just randomly pressing buttons. UNDERWATER MISSIONS The oceans are under enemy control. Gather a team of highly trained specialists (or at least people who claim they know what they're doing) and complete dangerous missions beneath the waves. - Locate hostile vessels with sonar and send them to the bottom of the sea. Preferably before they do the same to you. - Protect valuable cargo ships. Because apparently the military couldn't find anyone else to babysit them. - Hunt for treasures. Use sonar to search the ocean floor for lost riches, forgotten artifacts, and evidence of previous crews' poor decisions. - Slip past enemy destroyers undetected. Stay quiet. Stay hidden. And whatever you do, don't sneeze. COOPERATION Up to four crew members must work together to manage nine critical stations, including navigation, diving, sonar, periscope operations, engineering, and damage control. Your sonar operator tracks contacts while the rest of the crew keeps the submarine alive. When the sub catches fire or starts taking on water from twelve different holes at once, communication is the only thing standing between you and becoming fish food. Use proximity voice chat to: - Shout urgent orders. - Warn everyone about imminent disaster. - Explain why the catastrophe is definitely someone else's fault. And if a crewmate starts reading the manual during a torpedo attack, give ’em a friendly slap back to reality! Nothing says "successful mission" quite like a victory dance while all hell breaks loose. CUSTOMIZATION In S.O.N.A.R. every character is unique. Choose from dozens of uniforms, hats, and questionable fashion choices. Customize your equipment before deployment and unlock new gear as you level up. If you're going to make terrible decisions underwater, you should at least look good doing it. SURVIVAL Machines aren't the only things that break down. Humans do too. Manage your crew's food supplies, rest schedules, and overall well-being. Neglect them for too long and they'll become exhausted, seasick, delirious, or mysteriously incapable of following simple instructions. Health Tip: You really, really don't want to be vomiting inside your diving helmet when it's your turn to load the torpedoes. Trust us on this one. input.china_demand: Run an airline the competent way you wish they were like in real life. Open routes, buy aircraft, build the weekly schedule, and hire crew qualified to fly it. No cockpits, no cutscenes. Just the network, the numbers, and fierce rivals aiming to take a cut of your market share. Skylane is an airline tycoon where you never touch the plane's controls. You do the job that actually decides whether an airline lives: which city pairs to serve, how often, with which aircraft, and who is qualified to crew them. Start with one hub and one aircraft. input.china_demand: Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo open-world wuxia management game. Restore your ruined escort bureau with the ancient Mechanism Boat. Manage resources, trade, and fight with tower defense auto-battler gameplay. Seize territories and choose to be either a righteous hero or a ruthless jianghu overlord. Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo-developed open-world wuxia management game on Steam. It integrates caravan management, survival resource gathering, faction warfare, and tower defense auto-battler strategy gameplay. Powered by a dynamically interconnected living world system, it presents a vivid, unrestrained martial arts jianghu full of possibilities. 1. Core Lore During the chaotic Spring and Autumn Period, Fan Li forged an unparalleled divine treasure — the Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Endowed with incredible power, the boat helped the State of Wu restore its dynasty and end turmoil. After achieving greatness, Fan Li retired from public life. Using the boat’s ingenious mechanism technology, he dominated commerce and became the wealthiest sage of his era. Hundreds of years later, a Taoist priest from the Kongtong Sect discovered the sealed ancient vessel in a remote mountain cave while surveying feng shui. Harnessing its heaven-defying power, he reshaped the jianghu, conquered rival forces, unified the realm, and founded the Wu Dynasty, later honored as the Wu Ancestor. Knowing the boat’s power was too formidable and would trigger endless conflicts if leaked to the world, the Wu Ancestor resealed the artifact in an unknown hidden realm to secure lasting peace. As times changed and chaos returned to the jianghu, you awaken in the ruins of a massacred escort bureau with all memories lost. Guided by the old bureau accountant, you rediscover the long-lost Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Embark on a journey to revive your fallen escort agency and rise amid the turbulent martial arts world. 2. Core Game Systems 2.1 Immersive Survival & Management Experience realistic caravan simulation and meticulous bureau operation. Manage your guards’ daily lives, accommodation, and salaries. Poor resource supply, administrative negligence, or low team morale will deplete your Jianghu Reputation. Once reputation drops to zero, your bureau collapses and the game ends. Explore freely on foot or aboard your Mechanism Boat. Gather lumber, stone, fish, herbs and more. All resources can be sold directly or processed into advanced crafts and supplies. Build your own industrial chain for self-sufficiency and profitable trading. 2.2 Dynamic Interconnected World System The first chapter unlocks the entire Shu Region map, including 5 distinctive towns, dozens of resource-rich villages, and 15 influential sects. The whole world operates on a fully dynamic interconnected system where weather cycles, ecological changes, and commodity economies interact and influence one another in a real-time simulated ecosystem. Weather conditions affect exploration efficiency, trade route safety, and resource yields. Ecological abundance directly impacts market supply, driving real-time price fluctuations. Local specialties, sect goods, and rare relic resources circulate dynamically. Capitalize on shifting markets and chaotic situations to accumulate wealth and dominate regional trade. 2.3 Customizable Mechanism Boat — Mobile Stronghold The Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat serves as your upgradable, fully customizable mobile base. Redesign cabin layouts, build production lines, install processing facilities, and unlock advanced crafting formulas. Manage resource stockpiles, arrange production schedules, and assign guard manpower rationally. Achieve mass production of daily materials and combat supplies. Transform the ancient artifact into your portable production hub and unshakable jianghu fortress. 2.4 Tower Defense + Auto-Battler Hybrid Combat Innovatively combining tower defense deployment and auto-battler strategy. Build various defensive towers and combat devices on your deck, each with unique attributes and skills. Towers feature exclusive synergy bonds. Level up to unlock new affixes and advanced bond effects. Mix offense, crowd control, defense, and support to create countless unique combat builds. Adjust formations tactically to fend off bandit raids and sect sieges. 2.5 Global Faction Conquest System Every village and sect on the map is conquerable. Each stronghold provides exclusive specialties, resources, and geographical advantages. Occupy territories to monopolize local production and control vital trade routes for unique development bonuses. Expand your influence like map coloring. Grow from a ruined small bureau into a dominant force, seize villages, subdue sects, and eventually unify the entire Shu territory to build your own jianghu empire. 2.6 Ultimate Open-World Freedom No fixed storyline or forced moral alignment shapes your fate. You can walk the righteous path, escort caravans, uphold justice, and earn legendary fame. Or embrace chaos: steal from towns, cheat in gambles, ambush merchants, plunder villages, and occupy mountains as an outlaw overlord. Freely engage in duels, faction wars, trade competitions, or rural seclusion. Every choice crafts a unique life in this truly open and diverse wuxia world. input.china_demand: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage — scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover. And in a sport where tenths of a second matter, knowledge is often more valuable than raw performance. Five tiers of racing with many routes to reach the top. Whether it's from Karting to Open Wheel or Banger racing to Touring Cars, you're picking the route. Getting into the next series isn't just about winning. Drivers have careers of their own. Rivals develop. Sponsors can be offended. Contracts have teeth. Regulations change. Last year's dominance can become deemed illegal next season. You might have the fastest car and no money to run it. You might have the best driver and nothing worth putting them in. You might spend an entire season fighting for the last championship point that keeps the team alive. Grow from a workshop into a full constructor with a design studio, machine shop, wind tunnel and crash-test facilities. Design and develop your own cars part by part. The costs are high but the rewards come in trophies and expansions The factory is the game, the race is the exam build, prepare, staff and transport your team to the race A complete part lifecycle scavenge, buy, test, wear, break, design and manufacture. input.china_demand: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern. Animated reconstructions of classic wars Historical War: The Animation is not a real-time strategy game and not a sandbox wargame. It is a library of war films: famous campaigns reconstructed as short, playable records with play, pause, replay, and a scrubbable timeline. Napoleon is the dividing line. His campaigns and everything after are Modern Wars; everything earlier is Ancient Wars. Each film is about five minutes—long enough to follow the main axis of a battle, short enough to finish in one sitting. What you get Animated maps of advances, encirclements, retreats, and naval or air contact A timeline keyed to historical beats, with campaign notes Units that move along operational lines instead of appearing from nowhere Chinese and English interface, switchable at any time Ancient Wars Alexander the Great, the Punic Wars, Cannae, the Qin unification of China, Gaixia and Han Xin’s ten-sided ambush, Caesar, the Crusades, and the Mongol conquests. Modern Wars The Napoleonic wars, Trafalgar, Tsushima, Jutland, the 1940 campaign in France, the Battle of Britain, the Eastern Front 1941–1945, the Pacific War, Midway, the Bismarck Sea, the Atlantic wolfpacks, Guadalcanal, Big Week, Nianzhuang in the Huaihai Campaign, and the 1991 Gulf War. Who it is for Anyone who wants to see how a classic campaign actually unfolded on the map—history viewers and documentary-style war animation, not unit-command gameplay. input.china_demand: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site. WELCOME TO GROUNDWORK SIMULATOR Groundwork Simulator puts you behind the controls of heavy machinery, with a landscape to reshape and gold to uncover. Dig into the hillside, haul material across your site and set up the equipment that turns a bucket of dirt into your next gold recovery. Work at your own pace or share the job with friends. EVERY BUCKET CHANGES THE LANDSCAPE Dig trenches, cut into hillsides and build up piles as you shape your worksite. Every scoop changes the ground you work on, creating new routes, steeper slopes and fresh challenges. Plan your approach, the ground you leave behind becomes the foundation for your next job. REALISTIC PHYSICS Dig with a realistic excavation engine and simulated hydraulic feedback that brings resistance to every scoop. Feel your machine respond as the bucket meets the ground and material builds up inside it. Adjust your angle and work with the available hydraulic power to cut through the terrain, fill your bucket and lift the load. FROM DIRT TO GOLD Explore the land in search of gold-rich ground. Drill and test for deposits, choose your digging spot and set up your wash plant. Excavate promising material, wash it through the sluice boxes and process the concentrate on the shaking table, from your first test hole to your next gold recovery. WORK SOLO OR SHARE THE SITE Run the operation yourself or divide the work in online co-op. Take the excavator while a friend handles transport, or keep material moving together between the digging area and the wash plant. Coordinate your machines and turn a patch of untouched ground into a busy worksite. WATER SYSTEM Bring water to your washing operation with pumps and hoses. Position your equipment, route your connections across the site and get water flowing where it’s needed. As your worksite grows, adapt your setup to keep the washing operation supplied. TRANSPORT Load your heavy machinery onto a trailer and haul it by truck to your next worksite. Line up for loading, plan your route and navigate tight turns, slopes and rough terrain with a heavy load behind you. Unload your equipment where you need it and get to work. FIGHT THE TERRAIN Mud, slopes and rough ground make every route a decision. Watch your traction, choose your approach and take care with a heavy load. china_opportunities.value: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes. 🏡 The Village Is in Danger! The Demolition Crew Is Coming! This was a peaceful little village — until the demolition crew's bulldozers reached the village gate. The village chief gave the order, and everyone rushed to defend — Piggy Girl, Slingshot Boy, Blacksmith, Suona Lady… Who would have thought the last line of defense for their home would be this group of seemingly ordinary villagers? A relaxing strategy game blending Backpack-like , Roguelike , and Bullet Heaven gameplay. There's only one thing you need to do: Recruit, place, and upgrade your villager heroes within limited backpack slots — hold the line and drive the demolition crew back! 🎒 Backpack-like Gameplay: Your Grid Is the Battlefield Every hero takes up slots in your backpack. Limited slots, diverse heroes — Do you place one powerful Super Hero that takes up more slots? Or fill your board with many flexible heroes that take up fewer slots? How to make the optimal allocation within limited slots is the core strategic joy of this game. Each level is a brand-new choice. Smart layout is the key to victory. 🦸 12 Common Heroes, Each with Unique Skills 🐷 Piggy Girl — One shake of the piggy bank, coins come rolling in 🎯 Slingshot Boy — Ranged bounces, flexible damage 🔨 Blacksmith — Grants armor shields to adjacent allies 🥊 Sandbag Kid — Melee tank, knocks enemies back 🪀 Rubber Gunner — Binds enemies, crowd-control expert 🎯 Blowgun Girl — Charged crits, piercing shots 🧨 Firecracker Boy — Explosion range, burning damage over time 🌿 Old Healer — Healing and first aid, the team's medic 💧 Water Carrier — High-pressure water gun, AoE damage 🎺 Suona Lady — Charge boost, team-wide buffs 🔪 Butcher — Bleed and slow, weakens enemies 🚜 Tractor Uncle — Crushes and knocks back, plows through everything 🧬 Hero Fusion: Purple Turns Orange, Super Heroes Enter! Two specific Purple Heroes can be fused into one Orange Super Hero . Super Heroes have even more powerful ultimate abilities that can instantly turn the tide of battle! 11 Super Hero Fusion Recipes 🎆 Firework Mage = Firecracker Boy + Blowgun Girl ⚔️ Capy Swordsman = Butcher + Rubber Gunner 🚗 Rich Car Villager = Piggy Girl + Tractor Uncle 💰 Buffett Rich = Piggy Girl + Rubber Gunner 🧧 God of Wealth = Piggy Girl + Sandbag Kid 🧨 Firecracker Thrower = Blowgun Girl + Sandbag Kid 🌽 Corn Shooter = Slingshot Boy + Blowgun Girl 🛡️ Tank Commander = Blacksmith + Tractor Uncle 🪀 Capy Rubberman = Firecracker Boy + Slingshot Boy 🥋 Capy Warrior = Sandbag Kid + Old Healer 🥷 Capy Ninja = Rubber Gunner + Suona Lady Smart hero selection and team synergy are the key to victory! 🏰 Upgrade Your Village, Defend the Line Together It's not just heroes that can grow stronger — your village can be upgraded too! An upgraded village provides extra bonuses, fighting alongside you to hold the final line of defense. 🗺️ 50 Chapters, Get Stronger as You Fight The game contains 50 chapters , with difficulty escalating step by step. Can't win? No problem — every battle accumulates resources to strengthen heroes and upgrade your village. Next time, you'll be stronger. This is the charm of the Roguelike growth loop : failure isn't the end — it's the beginning of getting stronger. ✨ Game Features at a Glance 🎒 Backpack-like gameplay : Limited slots, unlimited strategy 🦸 12 Common Heroes + 11 Super Heroes : Endless fusion combinations 🧬 Purple fuses into Orange : Super Heroes turn the tide 🏰 Village upgrade system : Get stronger together, defend together 🗺️ 50 chapters : Rich content, high replayability 🎯 Roguelike + Bullet Heaven : Easy to pick up, satisfying to mow down 🧠 Relaxing yet brainy : Easy to learn, hard to master 🏡 Chinese village theme : Rustic charm, warm and fun 🎮 Made for Players Like You Fans of Backpack-like games Fans of Roguelike / Roguelite growth loops Fans of Bullet Heaven / Survivors-like mowing-down action Fans of strategic team-building and hero fusion Anyone looking for a relaxing yet brainy Tower Defense / Village Defense game Fans of Chinese-style, rural, and humorous themes 🏘️ Villagers, Assemble — Defend Your Home! The demolition crew's bulldozers are already rumbling toward the village. The village chief is calling you — rally the villagers and defend our village! The Demolition Crew Is Coming! This was a peaceful little village — until the demolition crew's bulldozers reached the village gate. The village chief gave the order, and everyone rushed to defend — Piggy Girl, Slingshot Boy, Blacksmith, Suona Lady… Who would have thought the last line of defense for their home would be this group of seemingly ordinary villagers? A relaxing strategy game blending Backpack-like , Roguelike , and Bullet Heaven gameplay. There's only one thing you need to do: Recruit, place, and upgrade your villager heroes within limited backpack slots — hold the line and drive the demolition crew back! 🎒 Backpack-like Gameplay: Your Grid Is the Battlefield Every hero takes up slots in your backpack. Limited slots, diverse heroes — Do you place one powerful Super Hero that takes up more slots? Or fill your board with many flexible heroes that take up fewer slots? How to make the optimal allocation within limited slots is the core strategic joy of this game. Each level is a brand-new choice. Smart layout is the key to victory. 🦸 12 Common Heroes, Each with Unique Skills 🐷 Piggy Girl — One shake of the piggy bank, coins come rolling in 🎯 Slingshot Boy — Ranged bounces, flexible damage 🔨 Blacksmith — Grants armor shields to adjacent allies 🥊 Sandbag Kid — Melee tank, knocks enemies back 🪀 Rubber Gunner — Binds enemies, crowd-control expert 🎯 Blowgun Girl — Charged crits, piercing shots 🧨 Firecracker Boy — Explosion range, burning damage over time 🌿 Old Healer — Healing and first aid, the team's medic 💧 Water Carrier — High-pressure water gun, AoE damage 🎺 Suona Lady — Charge boost, team-wide buffs 🔪 Butcher — Bleed and slow, weakens enemies 🚜 Tractor Uncle — Crushes and knocks back, plows through everything 🧬 Hero Fusion: Purple Turns Orange, Super Heroes Enter! Two specific Purple Heroes can be fused into one Orange Super Hero . Super Heroes have even more powerful ultimate abilities that can instantly turn the tide of battle! 11 Super Hero Fusion Recipes 🎆 Firework Mage = Firecracker Boy + Blowgun Girl ⚔️ Capy Swordsman = Butcher + Rubber Gunner 🚗 Rich Car Villager = Piggy Girl + Tractor Uncle 💰 Buffett Rich = Piggy Girl + Rubber Gunner 🧧 God of Wealth = Piggy Girl + Sandbag Kid 🧨 Firecracker Thrower = Blowgun Girl + Sandbag Kid 🌽 Corn Shooter = Slingshot Boy + Blowgun Girl 🛡️ Tank Commander = Blacksmith + Tractor Uncle 🪀 Capy Rubberman = Firecracker Boy + Slingshot Boy 🥋 Capy Warrior = Sandbag Kid + Old Healer 🥷 Capy Ninja = Rubber Gunner + Suona Lady Smart hero selection and team synergy are the key to victory! 🏰 Upgrade Your Village, Defend the Line Together It's not just heroes that can grow stronger — your village can be upgraded too! An upgraded village provides extra bonuses, fighting alongside you to hold the final line of defense. 🗺️ 50 Chapters, Get Stronger as You Fight The game contains 50 chapters , with difficulty escalating step by step. Can't win? No problem — every battle accumulates resources to strengthen heroes and upgrade your village. Next time, you'll be stronger. This is the charm of the Roguelike growth loop : failure isn't the end — it's the beginning of getting stronger. ✨ Game Features at a Glance 🎒 Backpack-like gameplay : Limited slots, unlimited strategy 🦸 12 Common Heroes + 11 Super Heroes : Endless fusion combinations 🧬 Purple fuses into Orange : Super Heroes turn the tide 🏰 Village upgrade system : Get stronger together, defend together 🗺️ 50 chapters : Rich content, high replayability 🎯 Roguelike + Bullet Heaven : Easy to pick up, satisfying to mow down 🧠 Relaxing yet brainy : Easy to learn, hard to master 🏡 Chinese village theme : Rustic charm, warm and fun 🎮 Made for Players Like You Fans of Backpack-like games Fans of Roguelike / Roguelite growth loops Fans of Bullet Heaven / Survivors-like mowing-down action Fans of strategic team-building and hero fusion Anyone looking for a relaxing yet brainy Tower Defense / Village Defense game Fans of Chinese-style, rural, and humorous themes 🏘️ Villagers, Assemble — Defend Your Home! input.china_demand: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes. 🏡 The Village Is in Danger! The Demolition Crew Is Coming! This was a peaceful little village — until the demolition crew's bulldozers reached the village gate. The village chief gave the order, and everyone rushed to defend — Piggy Girl, Slingshot Boy, Blacksmith, Suona Lady… Who would have thought the last line of defense for their home would be this group of seemingly ordinary villagers? A relaxing strategy game blending Backpack-like , Roguelike , and Bullet Heaven gameplay. There's only one thing you need to do: Recruit, place, and upgrade your villager heroes within limited backpack slots — hold the line and drive the demolition crew back! 🎒 Backpack-like Gameplay: Your Grid Is the Battlefield Every hero takes up slots in your backpack. Limited slots, diverse heroes — Do you place one powerful Super Hero that takes up more slots? Or fill your board with many flexible heroes that take up fewer slots? How to make the optimal allocation within limited slots is the core strategic joy of this game. Each level is a brand-new choice. Smart layout is the key to victory. 🦸 12 Common Heroes, Each with Unique Skills 🐷 Piggy Girl — One shake of the piggy bank, coins come rolling in 🎯 Slingshot Boy — Ranged bounces, flexible damage 🔨 Blacksmith — Grants armor shields to adjacent allies 🥊 Sandbag Kid — Melee tank, knocks enemies back 🪀 Rubber Gunner — Binds enemies, crowd-control expert 🎯 Blowgun Girl — Charged crits, piercing shots 🧨 Firecracker Boy — Explosion range, burning damage over time 🌿 Old Healer — Healing and first aid, the team's medic 💧 Water Carrier — High-pressure water gun, AoE damage 🎺 Suona Lady — Charge boost, team-wide buffs 🔪 Butcher — Bleed and slow, weakens enemies 🚜 Tractor Uncle — Crushes and knocks back, plows through everything 🧬 Hero Fusion: Purple Turns Orange, Super Heroes Enter! Two specific Purple Heroes can be fused into one Orange Super Hero . Super Heroes have even more powerful ultimate abilities that can instantly turn the tide of battle! 11 Super Hero Fusion Recipes 🎆 Firework Mage = Firecracker Boy + Blowgun Girl ⚔️ Capy Swordsman = Butcher + Rubber Gunner 🚗 Rich Car Villager = Piggy Girl + Tractor Uncle 💰 Buffett Rich = Piggy Girl + Rubber Gunner 🧧 God of Wealth = Piggy Girl + Sandbag Kid 🧨 Firecracker Thrower = Blowgun Girl + Sandbag Kid 🌽 Corn Shooter = Slingshot Boy + Blowgun Girl 🛡️ Tank Commander = Blacksmith + Tractor Uncle 🪀 Capy Rubberman = Firecracker Boy + Slingshot Boy 🥋 Capy Warrior = Sandbag Kid + Old Healer 🥷 Capy Ninja = Rubber Gunner + Suona Lady Smart hero selection and team synergy are the key to victory! 🏰 Upgrade Your Village, Defend the Line Together It's not just heroes that can grow stronger — your village can be upgraded too! An upgraded village provides extra bonuses, fighting alongside you to hold the final line of defense. 🗺️ 50 Chapters, Get Stronger as You Fight The game contains 50 chapters , with difficulty escalating step by step. Can't win? No problem — every battle accumulates resources to strengthen heroes and upgrade your village. Next time, you'll be stronger. This is the charm of the Roguelike growth loop : failure isn't the end — it's the beginning of getting stronger. ✨ Game Features at a Glance 🎒 Backpack-like gameplay : Limited slots, unlimited strategy 🦸 12 Common Heroes + 11 Super Heroes : Endless fusion combinations 🧬 Purple fuses into Orange : Super Heroes turn the tide 🏰 Village upgrade system : Get stronger together, defend together 🗺️ 50 chapters : Rich content, high replayability 🎯 Roguelike + Bullet Heaven : Easy to pick up, satisfying to mow down 🧠 Relaxing yet brainy : Easy to learn, hard to master 🏡 Chinese village theme : Rustic charm, warm and fun 🎮 Made for Players Like You Fans of Backpack-like games Fans of Roguelike / Roguelite growth loops Fans of Bullet Heaven / Survivors-like mowing-down action Fans of strategic team-building and hero fusion Anyone looking for a relaxing yet brainy Tower Defense / Village Defense game Fans of Chinese-style, rural, and humorous themes 🏘️ Villagers, Assemble — Defend Your Home! The demolition crew's bulldozers are already rumbling toward the village. The village chief is calling you — rally the villagers and defend our village! The Demolition Crew Is Coming! This was a peaceful little village — until the demolition crew's bulldozers reached the village gate. The village chief gave the order, and everyone rushed to defend — Piggy Girl, Slingshot Boy, Blacksmith, Suona Lady… Who would have thought the last line of defense for their home would be this group of seemingly ordinary villagers? A relaxing strategy game blending Backpack-like , Roguelike , and Bullet Heaven gameplay. There's only one thing you need to do: Recruit, place, and upgrade your villager heroes within limited backpack slots — hold the line and drive the demolition crew back! 🎒 Backpack-like Gameplay: Your Grid Is the Battlefield Every hero takes up slots in your backpack. Limited slots, diverse heroes — Do you place one powerful Super Hero that takes up more slots? Or fill your board with many flexible heroes that take up fewer slots? How to make the optimal allocation within limited slots is the core strategic joy of this game. Each level is a brand-new choice. Smart layout is the key to victory. 🦸 12 Common Heroes, Each with Unique Skills 🐷 Piggy Girl — One shake of the piggy bank, coins come rolling in 🎯 Slingshot Boy — Ranged bounces, flexible damage 🔨 Blacksmith — Grants armor shields to adjacent allies 🥊 Sandbag Kid — Melee tank, knocks enemies back 🪀 Rubber Gunner — Binds enemies, crowd-control expert 🎯 Blowgun Girl — Charged crits, piercing shots 🧨 Firecracker Boy — Explosion range, burning damage over time 🌿 Old Healer — Healing and first aid, the team's medic 💧 Water Carrier — High-pressure water gun, AoE damage 🎺 Suona Lady — Charge boost, team-wide buffs 🔪 Butcher — Bleed and slow, weakens enemies 🚜 Tractor Uncle — Crushes and knocks back, plows through everything 🧬 Hero Fusion: Purple Turns Orange, Super Heroes Enter! Two specific Purple Heroes can be fused into one Orange Super Hero . Super Heroes have even more powerful ultimate abilities that can instantly turn the tide of battle! 11 Super Hero Fusion Recipes 🎆 Firework Mage = Firecracker Boy + Blowgun Girl ⚔️ Capy Swordsman = Butcher + Rubber Gunner 🚗 Rich Car Villager = Piggy Girl + Tractor Uncle 💰 Buffett Rich = Piggy Girl + Rubber Gunner 🧧 God of Wealth = Piggy Girl + Sandbag Kid 🧨 Firecracker Thrower = Blowgun Girl + Sandbag Kid 🌽 Corn Shooter = Slingshot Boy + Blowgun Girl 🛡️ Tank Commander = Blacksmith + Tractor Uncle 🪀 Capy Rubberman = Firecracker Boy + Slingshot Boy 🥋 Capy Warrior = Sandbag Kid + Old Healer 🥷 Capy Ninja = Rubber Gunner + Suona Lady Smart hero selection and team synergy are the key to victory! 🏰 Upgrade Your Village, Defend the Line Together It's not just heroes that can grow stronger — your village can be upgraded too! An upgraded village provides extra bonuses, fighting alongside you to hold the final line of defense. 🗺️ 50 Chapters, Get Stronger as You Fight The game contains 50 chapters , with difficulty escalating step by step. Can't win? No problem — every battle accumulates resources to strengthen heroes and upgrade your village. Next time, you'll be stronger. This is the charm of the Roguelike growth loop : failure isn't the end — it's the beginning of getting stronger. ✨ Game Features at a Glance 🎒 Backpack-like gameplay : Limited slots, unlimited strategy 🦸 12 Common Heroes + 11 Super Heroes : Endless fusion combinations 🧬 Purple fuses into Orange : Super Heroes turn the tide 🏰 Village upgrade system : Get stronger together, defend together 🗺️ 50 chapters : Rich content, high replayability 🎯 Roguelike + Bullet Heaven : Easy to pick up, satisfying to mow down 🧠 Relaxing yet brainy : Easy to learn, hard to master 🏡 Chinese village theme : Rustic charm, warm and fun 🎮 Made for Players Like You Fans of Backpack-like games Fans of Roguelike / Roguelite growth loops Fans of Bullet Heaven / Survivors-like mowing-down action Fans of strategic team-building and hero fusion Anyone looking for a relaxing yet brainy Tower Defense / Village Defense game Fans of Chinese-style, rural, and humorous themes 🏘️ Villagers, Assemble — Defend Your Home! china_opportunities.value: Drive your tank through zombie hordes! Backpack-like + roguelike bullet-heaven shooter. Merge weapons, upgrade tanks, collect energy cores & sets, research tech. 5 difficulties from easy to inferno. The End Has Come — Drive Your Tank and Fight Your Way Out Zombies roam. Civilization has collapsed. You are the last armored commander, driving a heavy tank into waves of the infected, blasting a path through with barrage after barrage. This is an easy-to-pick-up Backpack-like + Roguelike game that blends strategic build-crafting with bullet-heaven shooting . Every run is a brand-new survival challenge. Backpack-Style Weapon Builds — Stack Them and Get Stronger Drag weapons into your tank slots and build your own personal firepower network. The game offers 4 weapon rarities , from Common to Legendary — the higher the rarity, the greater the power. Single-Target Weapons : High burst, fast fire rate — perfect for elites and bosses AoE Weapons : Wide coverage, screen-clearing carnage — built to slaughter infected swarms Support Weapons : No direct attacks, but they boost attack speed, restore HP, grant shields, and generate energy Multiple identical weapons can be merged and upgraded — two become one stronger weapon, evolving through rarities. The more you stack, the harder you hit. The firepower keeps rolling. That's the addictive growth loop of a backpack-like. Upgrade Your Tank — Expand Your Arsenal Your tank isn't just a vehicle — it's your mobile base. Upgrading your tank unlocks more weapon slots and raises max HP , letting you carry more weapons and withstand fiercer assaults. More slots mean freer builds. An entire tank of weapons firing at once — experience true bullet-heaven chaos. Collect Energy Cores — Activate Set Bonuses Every run drops Energy Cores . Different cores carry different skills — boosting attack, raising crit, speeding up energy recovery, or improving survivability. Collecting a full set of cores activates set bonuses , delivering game-changing extra effects. There's no single correct build — every run can play out a different way. Research Tech — Build Long-Term Progression Beyond the in-run roguelike build-crafting, the tech tree in the Research Lab is your long-term path to power. Research different technologies to permanently boost tank stats, weapon effects, and resource gains. Can't win? Go research. Max out your tech and come back to dominate. The pacing keeps you engaged without burnout. 5 Difficulties — From Relaxing to Inferno The game features 5 difficulty levels : Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, and Inferno. Lower difficulties are relaxing and satisfying — perfect for unwinding. Higher difficulties test your build and execution — made for hardcore players. Whether you want to casually blast zombies or push your limits, there's a pace for you. Game Features 🚜 Backpack-like + Roguelike : Drag-and-merge weapons, randomized builds every run, extremely high replayability 🔫 Bullet-Heaven Shooting : Multiple weapons firing at once, screen-filling bullets, maximum hack-and-slash satisfaction 🧟 Zombie Apocalypse Setting : Wave after wave of infected, each deadlier than the last 🧩 Strategic Builds : Single-target, AoE, and support weapons — endless combinations ⚙️ Tank Upgrades : Unlock slots, raise HP, build a mobile arsenal 💎 Energy Cores + Sets : Collect cores, activate set bonuses, play any build you want 🔬 Tech Research : Permanent progression — the more you research, the stronger you become 🎮 5 Difficulties : From casual relaxation to hardcore inferno — content for every player Ready to drive your tank and crush the infected swarm? рыбалки,Коллекционирование рыб,Лёгкий геймплей,Euro Truck Simulator 2,Евро Трак Симулятор 2,Симулятор вождения,Грузовики,Европа The End Has Come — Drive Your Tank and Fight Your Way Out Zombies roam. Civilization has collapsed. You are the last armored commander, driving a heavy tank into waves of the infected, blasting a path through with barrage after barrage. This is an easy-to-pick-up Backpack-like + Roguelike game that blends strategic build-crafting with bullet-heaven shooting . Every run is a brand-new survival challenge. Backpack-Style Weapon Builds — Stack Them and Get Stronger Drag weapons into your tank slots and build your own personal firepower network. The game offers 4 weapon rarities , from Common to Legendary — the higher the rarity, the greater the power. Single-Target Weapons : High burst, fast fire rate — perfect for elites and bosses AoE Weapons : Wide coverage, screen-clearing carnage — built to slaughter infected swarms Support Weapons : No direct attacks, but they boost attack speed, restore HP, grant shields, and generate energy Multiple identical weapons can be merged and upgraded — two become one stronger weapon, evolving through rarities. The more you stack, the harder you hit. The firepower keeps rolling. That's the addictive growth loop of a backpack-like. Upgrade Your Tank — Expand Your Arsenal Your tank isn't just a vehicle — it's your mobile base. Upgrading your tank unlocks more weapon slots and raises max HP , letting you carry more weapons and withstand fiercer assaults. More slots mean freer builds. An entire tank of weapons firing at once — experience true bullet-heaven chaos. Collect Energy Cores — Activate Set Bonuses Every run drops Energy Cores . Different cores carry different skills — boosting attack, raising crit, speeding up energy recovery, or improving survivability. Collecting a full set of cores activates set bonuses , delivering game-changing extra effects. There's no single correct build — every run can play out a different way. Research Tech — Build Long-Term Progression Beyond the in-run roguelike build-crafting, the tech tree in the Research Lab is your long-term path to power. Research different technologies to permanently boost tank stats, weapon effects, and resource gains. Can't win? Go research. Max out your tech and come back to dominate. The pacing keeps you engaged without burnout. 5 Difficulties — From Relaxing to Inferno The game features 5 difficulty levels : Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, and Inferno. Lower difficulties are relaxing and satisfying — perfect for unwinding. Higher difficulties test your build and execution — made for hardcore players. Whether you want to casually blast zombies or push your limits, there's a pace for you. input.china_demand: Drive your tank through zombie hordes! Backpack-like + roguelike bullet-heaven shooter. Merge weapons, upgrade tanks, collect energy cores & sets, research tech. 5 difficulties from easy to inferno. The End Has Come — Drive Your Tank and Fight Your Way Out Zombies roam. Civilization has collapsed. You are the last armored commander, driving a heavy tank into waves of the infected, blasting a path through with barrage after barrage. This is an easy-to-pick-up Backpack-like + Roguelike game that blends strategic build-crafting with bullet-heaven shooting . Every run is a brand-new survival challenge. Backpack-Style Weapon Builds — Stack Them and Get Stronger Drag weapons into your tank slots and build your own personal firepower network. The game offers 4 weapon rarities , from Common to Legendary — the higher the rarity, the greater the power. Single-Target Weapons : High burst, fast fire rate — perfect for elites and bosses AoE Weapons : Wide coverage, screen-clearing carnage — built to slaughter infected swarms Support Weapons : No direct attacks, but they boost attack speed, restore HP, grant shields, and generate energy Multiple identical weapons can be merged and upgraded — two become one stronger weapon, evolving through rarities. The more you stack, the harder you hit. The firepower keeps rolling. That's the addictive growth loop of a backpack-like. Upgrade Your Tank — Expand Your Arsenal Your tank isn't just a vehicle — it's your mobile base. Upgrading your tank unlocks more weapon slots and raises max HP , letting you carry more weapons and withstand fiercer assaults. More slots mean freer builds. An entire tank of weapons firing at once — experience true bullet-heaven chaos. Collect Energy Cores — Activate Set Bonuses Every run drops Energy Cores . Different cores carry different skills — boosting attack, raising crit, speeding up energy recovery, or improving survivability. Collecting a full set of cores activates set bonuses , delivering game-changing extra effects. There's no single correct build — every run can play out a different way. Research Tech — Build Long-Term Progression Beyond the in-run roguelike build-crafting, the tech tree in the Research Lab is your long-term path to power. Research different technologies to permanently boost tank stats, weapon effects, and resource gains. Can't win? Go research. Max out your tech and come back to dominate. The pacing keeps you engaged without burnout. 5 Difficulties — From Relaxing to Inferno The game features 5 difficulty levels : Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, and Inferno. Lower difficulties are relaxing and satisfying — perfect for unwinding. Higher difficulties test your build and execution — made for hardcore players. Whether you want to casually blast zombies or push your limits, there's a pace for you. Game Features 🚜 Backpack-like + Roguelike : Drag-and-merge weapons, randomized builds every run, extremely high replayability 🔫 Bullet-Heaven Shooting : Multiple weapons firing at once, screen-filling bullets, maximum hack-and-slash satisfaction 🧟 Zombie Apocalypse Setting : Wave after wave of infected, each deadlier than the last 🧩 Strategic Builds : Single-target, AoE, and support weapons — endless combinations ⚙️ Tank Upgrades : Unlock slots, raise HP, build a mobile arsenal 💎 Energy Cores + Sets : Collect cores, activate set bonuses, play any build you want 🔬 Tech Research : Permanent progression — the more you research, the stronger you become 🎮 5 Difficulties : From casual relaxation to hardcore inferno — content for every player Ready to drive your tank and crush the infected swarm? рыбалки,Коллекционирование рыб,Лёгкий геймплей,Euro Truck Simulator 2,Евро Трак Симулятор 2,Симулятор вождения,Грузовики,Европа The End Has Come — Drive Your Tank and Fight Your Way Out Zombies roam. Civilization has collapsed. You are the last armored commander, driving a heavy tank into waves of the infected, blasting a path through with barrage after barrage. This is an easy-to-pick-up Backpack-like + Roguelike game that blends strategic build-crafting with bullet-heaven shooting . Every run is a brand-new survival challenge. Backpack-Style Weapon Builds — Stack Them and Get Stronger Drag weapons into your tank slots and build your own personal firepower network. The game offers 4 weapon rarities , from Common to Legendary — the higher the rarity, the greater the power. Single-Target Weapons : High burst, fast fire rate — perfect for elites and bosses AoE Weapons : Wide coverage, screen-clearing carnage — built to slaughter infected swarms Support Weapons : No direct attacks, but they boost attack speed, restore HP, grant shields, and generate energy Multiple identical weapons can be merged and upgraded — two become one stronger weapon, evolving through rarities. The more you stack, the harder you hit. The firepower keeps rolling. That's the addictive growth loop of a backpack-like. Upgrade Your Tank — Expand Your Arsenal Your tank isn't just a vehicle — it's your mobile base. Upgrading your tank unlocks more weapon slots and raises max HP , letting you carry more weapons and withstand fiercer assaults. More slots mean freer builds. An entire tank of weapons firing at once — experience true bullet-heaven chaos. Collect Energy Cores — Activate Set Bonuses Every run drops Energy Cores . Different cores carry different skills — boosting attack, raising crit, speeding up energy recovery, or improving survivability. Collecting a full set of cores activates set bonuses , delivering game-changing extra effects. There's no single correct build — every run can play out a different way. Research Tech — Build Long-Term Progression Beyond the in-run roguelike build-crafting, the tech tree in the Research Lab is your long-term path to power. Research different technologies to permanently boost tank stats, weapon effects, and resource gains. Can't win? Go research. Max out your tech and come back to dominate. The pacing keeps you engaged without burnout. 5 Difficulties — From Relaxing to Inferno The game features 5 difficulty levels : Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, and Inferno. Lower difficulties are relaxing and satisfying — perfect for unwinding. Higher difficulties test your build and execution — made for hardcore players. Whether you want to casually blast zombies or push your limits, there's a pace for you. china_opportunities.value: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly. A brand-new title that's easy to pick up yet packed with strategic depth — blending bullet-hell shooting, inventory management, light Roguelike, and tower defense elements into one addictive experience. Step into a magical world under siege — face wave after wave of relentless monster hordes, build the ultimate hero lineup, construct an unbreakable defense, and protect the world you call home! 🧙 Random Recruitment, Strategic Formations Every run, you'll randomly recruit a unique set of heroes with distinct abilities. How you allocate and upgrade these heroes within limited grid slots is the key to stopping enemy assaults. With 100+ story chapter stages to conquer, every level is a fresh strategic challenge. ⚔️ Deep Hero System, Endless Tactical Combos The game features a rich and deep hero system, with each hero falling into distinct combat roles: Single-Target Burst : Specializes in eliminating elite enemies AOE Damage : Clears out swarms of minions Support & Buff : Provides powerful team-wide reinforcements Each hero occupies a different number of inventory grid slots — making optimal use of limited grid space is an extreme test of your strategic vision. Some heroes, when merged to max level, can evolve into two different branches of super heroes — choosing the right evolution path and team composition is the core of victory. 🛡️ Goddesses Descend, Defend Your Castle You can also recruit goddesses with unique styles. Each goddess possesses randomly generated skill affixes that provide unique buffs to your defense line. Encountering and nurturing each goddess is one of the key factors on the path to victory. 🏰 Castle Upgrades, Unlock Exclusive Skills Your castle can also be upgraded! When you have enough resources, don't forget to upgrade your castle. Especially in the early game, castle star-upgrades are crucial — each star upgrade unlocks exclusive castle skills, bringing game-changing improvements to your defense. 🔁 Failure Is Growth, Get Stronger Every Run Even if you can't clear a stage right away, don't worry. Every battle accumulates resources for you to strengthen weapons, upgrade your sanctuary, and train beautiful female officers. Grow stronger over time and conquer all kinds of high-difficulty stages, experiencing the satisfaction of progression and breakthrough. 💻 Low Spec Friendly, Play Without Worry The game has extremely low PC requirements — the vast majority of players can run it smoothly without worrying about hardware barriers. 🎮 Core Features at a Glance ✅ Inventory Management + Light Roguelike — a new experience every run ✅ Bullet-Hell Shooting + Tower Defense Strategy — fast-paced and brain-bending ✅ 100+ Story Chapter Stages — ultra-long playtime ✅ Diverse Hero System — Single-Target / AOE / Support free combinations ✅ Hero Evolution Branches — Super Heroes await your unlock ✅ Goddess Recruitment System — Random skill affix combinations ✅ Castle Star-Upgrade Mechanic — Exclusive skills unlocked step input.china_demand: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly. A brand-new title that's easy to pick up yet packed with strategic depth — blending bullet-hell shooting, inventory management, light Roguelike, and tower defense elements into one addictive experience. Step into a magical world under siege — face wave after wave of relentless monster hordes, build the ultimate hero lineup, construct an unbreakable defense, and protect the world you call home! 🧙 Random Recruitment, Strategic Formations Every run, you'll randomly recruit a unique set of heroes with distinct abilities. How you allocate and upgrade these heroes within limited grid slots is the key to stopping enemy assaults. With 100+ story chapter stages to conquer, every level is a fresh strategic challenge. ⚔️ Deep Hero System, Endless Tactical Combos The game features a rich and deep hero system, with each hero falling into distinct combat roles: Single-Target Burst : Specializes in eliminating elite enemies AOE Damage : Clears out swarms of minions Support & Buff : Provides powerful team-wide reinforcements Each hero occupies a different number of inventory grid slots — making optimal use of limited grid space is an extreme test of your strategic vision. Some heroes, when merged to max level, can evolve into two different branches of super heroes — choosing the right evolution path and team composition is the core of victory. 🛡️ Goddesses Descend, Defend Your Castle You can also recruit goddesses with unique styles. Each goddess possesses randomly generated skill affixes that provide unique buffs to your defense line. Encountering and nurturing each goddess is one of the key factors on the path to victory. 🏰 Castle Upgrades, Unlock Exclusive Skills Your castle can also be upgraded! When you have enough resources, don't forget to upgrade your castle. Especially in the early game, castle star-upgrades are crucial — each star upgrade unlocks exclusive castle skills, bringing game-changing improvements to your defense. 🔁 Failure Is Growth, Get Stronger Every Run Even if you can't clear a stage right away, don't worry. Every battle accumulates resources for you to strengthen weapons, upgrade your sanctuary, and train beautiful female officers. Grow stronger over time and conquer all kinds of high-difficulty stages, experiencing the satisfaction of progression and breakthrough. 💻 Low Spec Friendly, Play Without Worry The game has extremely low PC requirements — the vast majority of players can run it smoothly without worrying about hardware barriers. 🎮 Core Features at a Glance ✅ Inventory Management + Light Roguelike — a new experience china_opportunities.value: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop! Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one This Game Is for You If You Enjoy: Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it. management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. input.china_demand: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop! Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one This Game Is for You If You Enjoy: Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it. management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. input.china_demand: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help. The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush. Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time. Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter. Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries. Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows. Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. input.china_demand: Start as a Chinese chef and build your restaurant from scratch. Cook, manage menu, set prices, keep customers happy, balance costs & profits. Reputation matters—lose it and customers won't return. Made by a dev with 10 years as a Chinese chef. Step into the shoes of a Chinese chef and build your own restaurant from the ground up! From setting up your kitchen to preparing the day's dishes and keeping customers happy, every decision affects how your restaurant performs. Set Up Your Kitchen Start small by purchasing the equipment you need to get your kitchen up and running. Prepare Your Daily Menu Choose the dishes you want to serve and cook them for the day. Plan your menu carefully to attract customers and keep your restaurant running smoothly. Serve Your Customers Place your freshly cooked dishes in the food warmers and get ready for customers to arrive. Keep Customers Happy Customers' moods depend on waiting times, food quality, and prices. Want to charge more for your dishes? You'll need to provide quality food and good service to keep customers coming back. Experience Chinese Restaurant Life Experience the day-to-day operations of a Chinese restaurant, with a variety of Chinese dishes to prepare and serve. And yes, we're talking about Chinese food you'd actually find in a Chinese restaurant, not fortune cookies, General Tso's chicken, or sweet and sour chicken! Start with a small restaurant, improve your cooking skills, and grow your business one step at a time. Can you become a master chef and build a successful Chinese restaurant?
